component.name: Sotto
component.summary: Voice typing for Linux: the text appears while you speak
Голосовой ввод для Linux: текст появляется, пока вы говорите

description.p: Press a key and speak: Sotto recognises your speech on your computer and types each phrase where the cursor is as soon as you pause. Nothing leaves your computer; the only network access is the one-time model download, which is checked against the published SHA-256 sums.

GigaAM v3, the most accurate open model for Russian, and Parakeet TDT v3, for 25 European languages, run fast on an ordinary processor; Whisper covers 99 languages and uses the GPU through Vulkan. Silero VAD cuts the speech into phrases at the pauses.

Sotto is a native Qt 6 application that follows your system theme. On Wayland the indicator floats above windows without taking focus. On KDE, GNOME and COSMIC the shortcut and pasting go through the desktop portals; on niri, Hyprland, sway and other compositors Sotto shows the key binding to add and pastes with wtype.
